haiku.problem: "Secretly" is not in the verses. Joseph instructs the steward openly in 44:2, so the question adds a detail the lesson doesn't give.

The statement is attributed to the wrong speaker. In 44:9 it is the brothers who say the rest will become slaves, and in 44:10 the steward says the opposite, that only the one found will be a slave and the rest will be free of blame. The question should name the brothers or be reworded.
